_comment: Template for ~/.config/seckit/defaults.json. Copy it there (chmod 600) so you can run the short `seckit run -- <cmd>` form without repeating --service/--account. Contains NO secret values — only scope identifiers and the names of env vars Hermes expects. The actual key values live in the macOS login Keychain (set via `seckit set --stdin`).
_names_comment: LLM_API_KEY is the local llama-swap default (a bearer token, only if your proxy requires one). Add the env-var names your active profile/providers reference via key_env. Cloud examples: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (Anthropic Cloud), OPENAI_API_KEY (OpenAI-compatible), or the matching key for any hosted Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Provision each one with: printf '%s' '<key>' | seckit set --name <NAME> --stdin --kind api_key --service hermes --account local-dev
